title: ampelopsis sinica var. hancei
intro: Ampelopsis sinica var. hancei, commonly known as Chinese Ampelopsis or Chinese Vine, is a plant species that belongs to the grape family (Vitaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, and is traditionally used to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ampelopsis sinica var. hancei include its ability to calm inflammation, relieve pain, and regulate immune responses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
